# MutableStatementsMixin { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin()
```

Statements changed in place: a timeline's and a bundle's.

Every method returns the holder, for chaining. A pair whose property
or value uses a prefix the holder's context lacks is refused before
anything changes; :meth:`add_prefix` declares one.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add_belief](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_belief) | Record *actor*'s belief in the pair ``(property, value)``. |
| [add_candidate](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_candidate) | Offer the pair ``(property, value)`` as a candidate, without stating it. |
| [add_prefix](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_prefix) | Declare a prefix the holder's statements may use. |
| [add_statement](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_statement) | State the pair ``(property, value)``. |
| [add_verb](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_verb) | State a verb of the catalogue in one system's vocabulary. |
| [remove_statement](#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.remove_statement) | Remove the pair ``(property, value)`` and its entry. |

### add_belief { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_belief }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_belief(
    property,
    value,
    *,
    actor,
    belief,
    date=None,
    note=None,
    node=(),
)
```

Record *actor*'s belief in the pair ``(property, value)``.

The pair's entry, made where the pair has none, records the belief,
replacing the actor's earlier one (:func:`timetoshare.with_belief`).
Whether the pair is stated is left as it is: believing a stated
pair ``"false"`` records the belief and never removes the pair, and
every other actor's belief stands. A candidate the actor believes
``"false"`` is left out of :meth:`get_candidates` for that actor.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type                                                                   | Description                                                           | Default    |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| property | [str](`str`)                                                           | The property, as for :meth:`add_statement`.                           | _required_ |
| value    | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                    | The value, as for :meth:`add_statement`.                              | _required_ |
| actor    | [str](`str`)                                                           | Who holds the belief, an IRI.                                         | _required_ |
| belief   | [BeliefValue](`timetoalign.core.provenance.BeliefValue`)               | ``"true"``, ``"false"`` or ``"unlikely"``.                            | _required_ |
| date     | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None | The day, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None. | `None`     |
| note     | [str](`str`) \| None                                                   | A remark.                                                             | `None`     |
| node     | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`)                | The value node whose pair is meant.                                   | `()`       |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *belief* is none of the three, the date is no calendar date, *node* addresses no value node, or a prefix is undeclared. |

### add_candidate { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_candidate }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_candidate(
    property,
    value,
    *,
    stated_by,
    method,
    date=None,
    service=None,
    basis=(),
    match=None,
    note=None,
    node=(),
)
```

Offer the pair ``(property, value)`` as a candidate, without stating it.

The candidate is an entry of the pair alone; it takes the place of
another entry of the pair, whose beliefs it keeps
(:func:`timetoshare.with_candidate`). A loader or a service
offering it holds no belief; :meth:`add_statement` states it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                   | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| property  | [str](`str`)                                                           | The property, as for :meth:`add_statement`.                           | _required_ |
| value     | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                    | The value, as for :meth:`add_statement`.                              | _required_ |
| stated_by | [str](`str`) \| [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[str](`str`)\] | Who offers it: an IRI, or several.                                    | _required_ |
| method    | [str](`str`)                                                           | ``manual``, ``reconciled``, ``imported``, ``inferred`` or an IRI.     | _required_ |
| date      | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None | The day, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None. | `None`     |
| service   | [str](`str`) \| None                                                   | The service that offered it, an IRI.                                  | `None`     |
| basis     | [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[str](`str`)\]                 | The sources the candidate rests on, IRIs.                             | `()`       |
| match     | [str](`str`) \| None                                                   | ``exact``, ``close``, ``broad``, ``narrow`` or ``related``.           | `None`     |
| note      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                   | A remark.                                                             | `None`     |
| node      | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`)                | The value node to offer the pair of.                                  | `()`       |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the pair is stated (``'wdt:P175' already has this value; a stated pair is no candidate``), a member is no valid provenance member, or a prefix is undeclared. |

### add_prefix { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_prefix }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_prefix(name, namespace)
```

Declare a prefix the holder's statements may use.

The catalogue's prefixes need no declaration. A manifest written
holding the holder carries the prefix in its ``@context`` when the
statements use it, a bundle's prefix also when its MatchClaim
table's actors use it.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the format refuses the declaration (``cannot declare the prefix 'unit' as ...``), or the holder declares the prefix already with another namespace (``the prefix 'foaf' already stands for 'http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/' on timeline 'cpt_1'``). The same declaration again changes nothing. |

### add_statement { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_statement }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_statement(
    property,
    value,
    *,
    node=(),
    provenance=None,
    actor=None,
    date=None,
)
```

State the pair ``(property, value)``.

A candidate of the pair becomes the stated pair's entry, its
beliefs kept (:func:`timetoshare.with_pair`). *provenance* sets the
entry's members; *actor*, the person stating the pair, is recorded
with the belief ``"true"``, replacing that actor's earlier belief.
A loader or a service gives *provenance* alone and holds no belief.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                                                                                                                        | Description                                                                                                                                                               | Default    |
|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| property   | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                | ``type`` ("is a"), a compact IRI or an absolute IRI.                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| value      | [Any](`typing.Any`)                                                                                                                         | A JSON value of the file's form: a literal, a value object, a node (``{"id": ...}``) or ``{"list": [...]}``; ``type`` takes a class IRI.                                  | _required_ |
| node       | [NodePath](`timetoalign.timelines.statements.NodePath`)                                                                                     | The value node to state the pair of; ``()`` the holder.                                                                                                                   | `()`       |
| provenance | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | How the pair was made, a :class:`~timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance` or its dictionary (``stated_by``, ``date``, ``method``, ...); its ``beliefs`` are recorded too. | `None`     |
| actor      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                                                        | The person stating the pair, an IRI.                                                                                                                                      | `None`     |
| date       | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None                                                                      | The day of *actor*'s belief, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None.                                                                                 | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the pair is stated already (``'wdt:P175' already has this value``), the property is no property, *node* addresses no value node, *provenance* is no provenance entry, *date* is given without *actor*, or a prefix is declared neither by the catalogue nor on the holder. |

### add_verb { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_verb }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.add_verb(
    verb,
    system,
    value,
    *,
    label=None,
    slots=None,
    alternative=0,
    provenance=None,
    actor=None,
    date=None,
    catalogue=None,
)
```

State a verb of the catalogue in one system's vocabulary.

The pairs of the system's pattern for the verb are stated in their
order, all or none (:func:`timetoshare.instantiate`), each as
:meth:`add_statement` states a pair, with *provenance* and *actor*.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                                                                        | Description                                                  | Default    |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| verb        | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                | The verb's ID in the catalogue (``performed_by``).           | _required_ |
| system      | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                | The system's ID (``wikidata``, ``fallback``).                | _required_ |
| value       | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                | What the pattern's slot ``?`` takes (``wd:Q235650``).        | _required_ |
| label       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                                                        | The label of the node the value becomes, if any.             | `None`     |
| slots       | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None                                                           | Values of the pattern's named slots (``{"role": "piano"}``). | `None`     |
| alternative | [int](`int`)                                                                                                                                | Which of the system's patterns to use.                       | `0`        |
| provenance  | [Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`) \| [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | As for :meth:`add_statement`.                                | `None`     |
| actor       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                                                        | As for :meth:`add_statement`.                                | `None`     |
| date        | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None                                                                      | As for :meth:`add_statement`.                                | `None`     |
| catalogue   | [Catalogue](`timetoshare.Catalogue`) \| None                                                                                                | The catalogue; the shipped one when None.                    | `None`     |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the catalogue has no such verb or pattern, a named slot has no value, or a pair is refused as by :meth:`add_statement`. |

### remove_statement { #timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.remove_statement }

```python
timelines.MutableStatementsMixin.remove_statement(property, value, *, node=())
```

Remove the pair ``(property, value)`` and its entry.

Removing is an edit of its own: no belief removes a pair.

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the pair is not stated (``'type' does not have this value``) or *node* addresses no value node. |
